Historical status paragraphs below describe earlier private candidates.
Necessary original notices and license copies remain applicable.

CURRENT LICENSE DECISION — 2026-10-18
Original SCEAN code, documentation, tests/build tools and original native Skills
are AGPL-3.0-only. LICENSE and LICENSE-SCOPE.md define the current scope; the
advanced-tavern-card-authoring MIT license is an explicit retained exception.
Memory origin is qualified in licenses/zeolas-source-snippets.json: the archived
functions are not attributed as established official Aventuras authorship.
Public release is held for an exact public source endpoint and explicit
publication authorization. No public repository or release has been created.
The new scean-opening-authoring 1.0.0 is active. Old opening, Palette and retired
Arcamage bodies remain excluded. The paragraphs below are historical notices,
not current payload or current license declarations; necessary notices remain.

HISTORICAL RECORDS (unchanged)

CANDIDATE SCOPE — 2026-10-18
No project-wide license is selected. Public release remains blocked pending license/author consistency review and user-supplied opening guidance. The old opening Skill, Palette and retired Arcamage Skill bodies/references are excluded. Old notices below are retained as provenance, not current payload declarations or a license grant. Private history locators are withheld separately.

RETAINED PRE-EXPORT NOTICES
2026-10-18 Palette removal candidate: Palette is removed from current source,
catalogs, method options and runtime; it is not shipped or selected in this branch.
Prior Palette paragraphs below are historical private-use provenance, not the
current payload or a public license grant. Old tags/Releases/history are retained.
Opening and character-authoring bytes are unchanged. See docs/PALETTE-REMOVAL.zh-TW.md.

DSH Card Studio private cross-machine package — source and rights record
Checked 2026-10-04. This file is not a new license grant.

Five original skills originate from Shizuku-Yume/Arcamage:
https://github.com/Shizuku-Yume/Arcamage
frontend/public/agent-skills/{character-design-deepener,lorebook-architect,
dialogue-and-prompt-tuner,opening-narrative-crafter,frontend-presentation-optimizer}
The upstream README declares MIT. Its linked LICENSE returned 404, and the
provided local source contains no complete copyright/license notice. Those
materials remain unverified/incomplete; no author name, year, or license text
has been invented. Existing text and attribution have been preserved.

Palette originates from the user's palette-skill-arcamage.zip, SHA256:
2a1995b20fa6fb26b06cf37c574b449bf49af92df25ebae0174e26b1e3245152
No license was supplied; ownership/redistribution rights are not established
by private repository visibility. The user explicitly authorized retaining
these supplied materials in their private repository for their own computers.
This scope is not a public redistribution grant. Public publication requires
separate rights review or replacement of the affected materials.

skills/sources.json records the original entry/reference hashes. Each skill's
SOURCE.txt identifies its origin. ORIGINAL-SKILL.md and original references
remain byte-for-byte intact. SKILL.md identifies project-authored DSH adapter
text separately from original methodology. No remote code is downloaded or run.
Palette references external mvu-guide.md that was not supplied; related changes
remain unavailable. The remote MVU URL is retained as inert source text only.

tavern-card-format-preservation and the DSH adapters were independently written
for this project. Their CCv2/v3 and SillyTavern primary-source citations do not
relicense any other skill. echo-xianyu/worldbook-skill is a separate CC BY-NC-SA
4.0 research source and is NOT included in this package.

This package contains no DSH executable/runtime, external skill scripts, real
cards, chat history, credentials, API keys, logs or mutable user workspace data.
